transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Before I make the final assignment for next Tuesday's expedited pediatric neurology intake opening, I need to gather current information from each of you. We have three referrals awaiting scheduling — Alder, Birch, and Cedar — and per clinic policy, the opening goes to the referral with the highest documented urgency score. Could neurology, the referral desk, and social work each share what they have on these three patients right now?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: The neurologist's review gives Birch an urgency score of 9 due to two recent unexplained loss-of-awareness episodes. Alder's score is 4 and Cedar's score is 6, making Birch the highest-scoring referral for the expedited opening.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to share something important about Alder. Alder already has a routine pediatric neurology appointment confirmed for Wednesday at 10:00 AM, and the family has accepted that appointment. The booking is in the referral desk's scheduling system but hasn't yet synchronized to the clinic-wide worklist, so it may not be visible to everyone yet.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: From social work: I want to share important access information about Cedar. Cedar's caregiver can attend a follow-up appointment only on Friday at 1:00 PM, and I have confirmed a qualified American Sign Language interpreter for that appointment through the hospital access office. This arrangement is not yet in the referral record, so it may not be visible to others on the team.
